title: Punctual weights
statement:
Use the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, put $q=p^a$, $k_0=\Fq$,
and let $k=\Fbar$ be the fixed algebraic closure of $k_0$. Fix a prime
$\ell\neq p$, write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], choose an algebraic closure $\Qlb$
of $\Ql$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and fix an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$. Let
$Y_0$ be a finite-type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] $k_0$-scheme, put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let
$\mathcal F$ be a constructible $\Qlb$-sheaf in the constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart],
carrying the Weil-sheaf structure [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For each closed point $y\in|Y_0|$, use the
closed-point notation [def-weil-point-counts-zeta], set $q_y=\#\kappa(y)$,
choose a $k_0$-embedding $\kappa(y)\hookrightarrow k$, and let
$\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}k\to Y$ be the associated geometric point over $k$. Let $F_y$ be the local geometric-Frobenius
operator [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] on $\mathcal F_{\bar y}$. At $\Qlb$, use the same local-operator composite with derived pullbacks and the iterated point transport of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], formed in the common-stage categories [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Apply the point-fiber functor [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] and degree-zero cohomology [def-weil-coefficient-cohomology-modules]; thus a point complex represented by $C_E$ over a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$ has actual stalk $\mathrm H^0(C_E)\otimes_E\Qlb$. The point transports are natural and compatible with finite coefficient extension [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural]. The spectrum is taken for this $\Qlb$-linear local operator. A scalar $\alpha\in\Qlb$ is an eigenvalue when $F_y(v)=\alpha v$ for some nonzero stalk vector $v$. For
$w\in\mathbf R$, call $\mathcal F$ punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$ if
every eigenvalue $\alpha$ of every $F_y$ satisfies

$$
 |\iota(\alpha)|=q_y^{w/2}.
$$

Here the absolute value is the complex absolute value [def-weil-complex-absolute-value], and the exponent uses the positive real power [def-weil-real-power].

Call $\mathcal F$ $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$ if there are an
integer $m\geq0$, constructible $\Qlb$-Weil subsheaves

$$
 0=\mathcal F_0\subset\mathcal F_1\subset\cdots\subset\mathcal F_m=\mathcal F,
 \qquad w_1,\ldots,w_m\in\mathbf R,\quad w_r\leq w,
$$

such that each quotient $\mathcal F_r/\mathcal F_{r-1}$ is punctually
$\iota$-pure of weight $w_r$.

The inclusions in the filtration mean monomorphisms of the underlying constructible heart that commute with the Weil structures. The quotient is the cokernel in that heart with its induced Weil structure: geometric-Frobenius pullback is exact on the heart [lem-a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact]. In particular the inclusions need not be strict. The eigenvalues are independent of the chosen embedding and associated geometric point, by [lem-weil-local-frobenius-conjugacy-class] at a common finite stage, followed by the point-transport compatibility with finite coefficient extension stated above. Conjugacy preserves eigenvalues: an intertwining isomorphism takes a nonzero eigenvector to a nonzero eigenvector with the same eigenvalue, and its inverse gives the converse.

The item is still imported and unreviewed live; it is not in route-pivot-dropped.txt and has no repair note. The statement keeps every hypothesis and both predicates of the source. It makes four things precise. (1) ybar is the point associated to a k0-embedding, the only case def-weil-local-frobenius-trace defines; eigenvalues do not depend on the choice. (2) F_y at Qbar is the same composite formed stagewise in C_Y, through the Qbar clauses of point-transport, derived-pullback, Fib_s and coefficient cohomology, on H^0(C_E) tensor_E Qbar; degree 0 holds by lem-a1. (3) An eigenvalue is defined by a nonzero eigenvector. (4) Quotients are heart cokernels with the induced Weil structure. Citation checks: lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural (2) supplies the scalar-extension compatibility of iota^{E'}, which identifies the Qbar operator with F_y^{(L)} tensor Qbar. lem-weil-local-frobenius-conjugacy-class is applied at a stage L where theta^{-1} exists, then tensored to Qbar; an intertwiner preserves eigenvalues. lem-a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact applies to g_Y as a k-morphism from (Y, Spec gamma o a_Y) to (Y, a_Y); the t-structure depends only on the scheme and the lemma's proof never uses k-linearity. It gives canonical Weil structures on cokernels. No cycle in any stmt_dep closure. Duplicates: def-weil-frobenius-module-weights, sk-d-real-weights and sk-d-dl-general-weights are not duplicates; the last cites the item. Batch-5: both flagged nodes, lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback-comparison-normalization (generic normalization of pullback along scheme isomorphisms) and lem-pod-texact-truncation-comparison (an abstract statement about t-exact functors and truncations), were already in the base closure through def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex and def-weil-constructible-heart.
